task.title: How to Stop Subscription Auto-Renewal
task.shortdesc: How organization administrators can disable auto-renewal for an active paid subscription.

prereq.p: You must have the Organization Administrator role in your organization.

context.p: Use this procedure for a paid subscription that was purchased through Verifone and currently has auto-renewal enabled.

step.cmd: Click Stop Auto-renewal in the subscription status and actions section.
step.stepresult: The system disables auto-renewal for the subscription.

step.cmd: Confirm that the button is no longer displayed and that the subscription status reflects the change.

postreq.p: Renew the subscription manually before the expiration date if you want to continue using the service.
postreq.note: Once disabled, you can re-enable auto-renewal from your Verifone account management interface.
If you delete the organization while auto-renewal is enabled, the system disables auto-renewal as part of the deletion process.
